Entry prose assigns SMN399 to the active site and RMN398 to the approach region.

The reviewed M0187 input corresponds to CHEBI:32382, whose retained MOL encodes formal charge -1 on atom10 (source a11). In contrast, both deposited component definitions state C8 H8 O3 and explicitly bond O12 to HO2; O12 maps to that carboxylate oxygen. Dictionary atom charge fields are absent, so a deposited zero charge is not asserted. This prevents exact canonical reaction-state identity; dictionary H does not determine bound protonation.

The two complete depicted-component locator maps retain all11 heavy atoms and explicit alpha H a66. Source-computed a9 R agrees with RMN C7 R and differs from SMN C7 S. One map preserves literal mapped bond orders; the phenyl reflection changes all six ring order tokens. Dictionary aromatic flags are preserved, not used to normalize the source graph. Neither map supplies full hydrogen/stereo state, a physical atom trajectory or a productive reactant pose. The retained source a9-a12 bondStereo W and dictionary C7-O8 bond-stereo N use different conventions and are not compared by this operation; only the reviewed atom R/S symbols are compared.

THIS IS THE STRUCTURE OF THE MANDELATE RACEMASE MUTANT
LYSINE 166 -> ARGININE CO-CRYSTALLIZED WITH THE SUBSTRATE
(R)-MANDELIC ACID.  THE SUBSTRATE THAT IS BOUND AT THE
ACTIVE SITE IS RESIDUE 399 FOR CONSISTENCY WITH THE
NOMENCLATURE OF PREVIOUS MANDELATE RACEMASE STRUCTURES.
IT HAS THE RESIDUE NAME SMN BECAUSE IT IS THE (S)-ISOMER.
THE (S)-ENANTIOMER PRESUMABLY AROSE FROM THE SLOW
RACEMIZATION OF (R)-MANDELATE.  THERE IS A SECOND SUBSTRATE
MOLECULE IN THE STRUCTURE; IT IS LOCATED IN THE REGION
LEADING TO THE ACTIVE SITE.  THIS MOLECULE IS THE
(R)-STEREOISOMER.  IT IS RESIDUE 398 AND, BY ANALOGY, HAS
THE RESIDUE NAME RMN.
